verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for an agent-building SDK, but the evidence pack has no documented scheduler, cron, or recurring-trigger feature. The adjacent items earn no credit: long-lived streaming sessions, background sessions in agent view, hosting guidance, and a user's own headless workflow built around `claude -p` are one-off execution or user-side arrangements, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
